name: done-chime
description: Plays a chime and shows a toast when a long Claude reply finishes, so you can look away while it works

minSeconds.title: Chime after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: Only replies that took at least this long chime; shorter ones stay quiet

chime.title: Chime sound
chime.description: arpeggio: four rising notes; rising: two rising notes; bell: one ringing bell; marimba: two soft wooden notes; ding-dong: doorbell; glass: one short ping
